newsitem.title: USA: Cole National raises $116 mln from offer.
newsitem.headline: Cole National raises $116 mln from offer.

text.p: Cole National Corp said it has sold 2.59 million shares of stock at $47 a share, raising $116.1 million in net proceeds to the company.
The number of Class A common shares outstanding after the transaction are 14,714,432, Cole National said in a statement issued July 28.
Cole National said proceeds will be used to reduce debt and for future acquisitions.
The offering was underwritten by Smith Barney Inc, McDonald & Co Securities Inc, as joint lead managers and joint bookrunners and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Inc as co-manager, the company said.
